Karthik / team —

Status from runtime tests:
- Perf SLOs: 95th p95 latency at target for 4k seq on dedicated pool. Full production-like run scheduled 4/26.
- Blocker: we found one regression in KV cache priming when using the new quantized kernels that affects cold-start throughput. Engineering has a patch candidate; need an additional validation window (2h) before I sign off.
- Fallback: yes — we will enable the compatible model variant as an automated fallback; need GTM to approve the user-facing note in the KB (Laura).

Requesting access from Acme: can Jordan/Lisa confirm they have shared the sample request traces to infra-access@redwood.com? That will let us run the canary with representative traffic.

Marcus
Director, Serving Runtime

- Kimberly: confirm pricing band selection and send DocuSign envelope (due 2027-04-23 17:00) — DocuSign: https://docusign.net/ACME-Contract-123
- Laura: publish KB note and enablement playbook with screenshots (due 2027-04-23 12:00).
- Karthik: rehearsal for announcement (4/28) and final GTM script (due 2027-04-27).
